name: Compare with a friend (mint + consent)
hostSurface: Opened from a secondary button under the aha card in the preview step and from the reveal ('Send yours back').
purpose: Mint and send a compare link in one tap, showing — before the link exists — exactly what the card will and will not reveal.
contents: A live preview of the card at share-card proportions; the privacy line 'This card shows readings and your city, never your address.'; an off-by-default 'Show my first name on the card' toggle + field; 'Copy link' on desktop / 'Share' on mobile. Fires t0_share_clicked with method 'compare'.
states: rate limited (distinct copy, not a generic error)
share cancelled (must not read as failure)
entryPoints: Under the aha card in the T0 preview
visualization: The card preview is the top of the sheet, at the proportions it will unfurl in a messenger, with the privacy sentence directly beneath it and the button last — so consent precedes the link rather than following it.
uxNote: The doc puts the privacy sentence in its own §Privacy section; if it lands after the link is made, the consent is retroactive. Also keep 'Compare with a friend' out of the WallBar footer, which already carries share + app-download — a third link there becomes a 3-up row on a phone.
